About Us

Engineering Expertise That Delivers Reliable Results

Najm Al-Madar is a specialized firm providing engineering and laboratory solutions for the oil, gas, and water treatment sector. We combine high technical competence with strict adherence to safety and quality standards to serve major oilfields.

Our work is led by a team of chemical engineers and laboratory supervisors with extensive field experience in oil and water analysis, corrosion control, and treatment-chemical evaluation.

Our Vision

To be the foremost and most trusted partner in laboratory and engineering solutions for the region's energy sector.

Our Mission

To provide precise analysis and treatment services that protect our clients' assets and enhance production efficiency.

Our Values

Precision, integrity, safety, and continuous improvement are the pillars of every project we undertake.

ISO
Certified Quality Standards
Our Services

Comprehensive Solutions Across Every Phase

A full suite of technical services tailored to the specific demands of the oil, gas, and water treatment industry.

01

Oil & Water Analysis

Precise characterization of crude oil and produced water, with full well-sample profiling to ensure production quality.

02

Treatment Chemical Evaluation

Testing and evaluating the effectiveness of treatment chemicals and selecting the optimal solutions for your operations.

03

Corrosion Control

Integrated monitoring and corrosion-mitigation programs for pipelines and equipment to extend operational life.

04

Laboratory Supervision

Professional lab management and supervision ensuring data accuracy and compliance with international standards.

05

Production Optimization

Technical studies and data analysis to improve operational performance and reduce running costs.

06

Technical Consulting

Specialized engineering consulting and technical support for projects across all operational and development stages.
